audit: AI Avatar Studio V1.4.0 technology handover readiness
severity_model: Impact(1-5) x Likelihood(1-5): 1-4 LOW, 5-9 MEDIUM, 10-15 HIGH, 16-25 CRITICAL

risks.risk: Quick Tunnel link-only access grants full Studio control to anyone with the URL (use ElevenLabs quota, create avatars, render). URL is temporary/random.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_STATIC — share_auth.py + AI_Avatar_Studio_Share.bat; link-only by design (V1.2.2). API key stays server-side (not leaked to browser).
risks.mitigation: Only share with trusted collaborators; Stop Sharing when done; rotate by stopping tunnel.
risks.recovery: Stop Sharing (AI_Avatar_Studio_Stop_Sharing.bat) kills the tunnel immediately.
risks.escalation: Migrate to Named Cloudflare Tunnel + Cloudflare Access + stable hostname when untrusted users need access.

risks.risk: Automated mouth-state detector cannot reliably distinguish talking vs neutral in the observed overlap range; may misclassify source videos.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_STATIC — validator.py SOURCE_MOUTH_STATE returns UNKNOWN for borderline cases; UI requires manual confirmation (renderMouthConfirm). Documented in code comments.
risks.mitigation: Manual mouth-state confirmation in Create Avatar flow; raw automated evidence stored separately, never overwrites user choice.
risks.recovery: Operator confirms 'Không nói'/'Có nói'/'Tôi không chắc' before prepare.

risks.risk: System knowledge concentrated in original developer; operational/recovery procedures were not documented.
risks.evidence: This handover package (START_HERE, OPERATIONS_RUNBOOK, TROUBLESHOOTING, BACKUP_RESTORE, ROLLBACK_RUNBOOK, etc.) + proven backup/restore/preflight drills.
risks.mitigation: Handover documentation set + preflight + backup tooling + teach-back checklist.
risks.recovery: Follow START_HERE.md.

risks.risk: RENDERS_DIR hardcoded to D:\CongThang_AI_Avatar\renders (studio/config.py:27); not env-overridable. Breaks if D: drive layout differs.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_STATIC — config.py:27.
risks.mitigation: STUDIO_RENDERS_DIR env override (config.py:22-26) + validate_renders_dir() existence/writable/free-space + prelight RENDER STORAGE block. PROVEN_REAL: preflight shows D:\...enders READY.
risks.recovery: Edit config.py:27 to point at the correct renders drive/dir.

risks.risk: Torch interpreter lives inside the experimental LatentSync repo (C:\CongThang\AI_avatar\latentsync_env). If that repo moves/deletes, the renderer interpreter vanishes.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_STATIC — runtime.py:9-23 documents this; resolution is centralized + overridable.
risks.mitigation: Set STUDIO_TORCH_PYTHON env var to a standalone env. No code-level coupling (production code never imports LatentSync).
risks.recovery: Recreate env from requirements-handover.lock + set STUDIO_TORCH_PYTHON.

risks.risk: No auto-reconciliation of in-flight jobs on Studio restart. If Studio crashes mid-render, the job row stays 'rendering'/'preparing_audio' indefinitely; GPU _BUSY set is in-memory (cleared on restart) so GPU is reusable but the job looks stuck.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_STATIC — render_service.start() only loads_truth+init_db; no stuck-job reconciliation.
risks.mitigation: render_service.start() now calls _reconcile_inflight_jobs() (run_studio.py:35 startup path) -> transient jobs marked failed 'Studio đã khởi động lại trong khi job đang chạy.' GPU _BUSY is fresh on restart. UNIT_TEST: TestReconcileInflight (transient->failed, complete/queued untouched).
risks.recovery: History → stuck job → Hủy (cancel) or Thử lại (retry).

risks.risk: Main launcher (AI_Avatar_Studio.bat) has no port-busy / already-running detection; starting a second Studio on occupied 8077 yields a raw Flask 'Address already in use' traceback.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_STATIC — AI_Avatar_Studio.bat:25 runs run_studio.py directly; run_studio.py:57 app.run with no bind guard.
risks.mitigation: Run AI_Avatar_Studio_Preflight.bat first (checks port). Document in runbook.
risks.recovery: Close the existing Studio, or reuse the running one.

risks.risk: No log rotation. Per-job logs (data/studio_runtime/logs/*.log) + diagnostics/ accumulate forever.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_STATIC — no rotation in code; diagnostics/ currently 2.2MB, logs small, but unbounded.
risks.mitigation: scripts/cleanup.py + AI_Avatar_Studio_Cleanup.bat: path-scoped retention (logs 30d, master WAV 30d, uploads 1d), keeps active-job logs, never touches diagnostics/renders/avatars. Current footprint: 29 logs / 0.39MB. Maintenance tool menu 6/7.
risks.recovery: Delete old diagnostics/*.log and studio_runtime/logs/*.log manually.

risks.risk: Master audio cache (data/studio_runtime/temp/master/*.wav) is reused but never cleaned; grows with distinct script+voice combos.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_STATIC — render_service._master_path caches by content hash; no eviction. uploads/ staging cleaned on complete (PROVEN_REAL).
risks.mitigation: Periodic cleanup of temp/master/*.wav (documented).
risks.recovery: Delete data/studio_runtime/temp/master/*.wav (regenerated on demand).

risks.risk: Prepared avatars (35GB, 19 dirs) live on C: which has ~80GB free; expensive to reconstruct (~20-30min each). No automated file backup of these binaries.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_REAL — disk measurement: avatars=34.9GB, C: free=82GB.
risks.mitigation: Periodic file-copy backup of data/avatars + data/input/avatar_sources to D: (documented in BACKUP_RESTORE.md).
risks.recovery: Restore from file backup OR re-prepare from raw source (expensive).

risks.risk: DB backup/restore is PROVEN_REAL, but full restore of the 35GB avatar binaries has not been drilled (only documented).
risks.evidence: DB restore drill PROVEN_REAL (integrity ok, counts match). File restore of avatars = UNKNOWN (not drilled).
risks.mitigation: Representative avatar backup+restore PROVEN_REAL: doTrang_closeup+mc_hamai_mid backed up (1480 files, sha256 manifest), restored to isolated location, 0 checksum mismatches, _check_ready=True for both, short render from restored copy (1080x1920 25fps audio+video) PROVEN_REAL_PASS. FULL_35GB_COPY_NOT_EXECUTED (procedure documented in BACKUP_RESTORE.md).
risks.recovery: xcopy/robocopy data/avatars back from backup drive.

risks.risk: No requirements lock committed; the torch env is 107 packages. Recreating the env on another machine requires the freeze snapshot.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_REAL — pip freeze captured to diagnostics/handover/pip_freeze_torch.txt (107 lines) + py310 (98).
risks.mitigation: Fresh-env rebuild FULLY_REPRODUCIBLE (PROVEN_REAL): new venv from system py310 (NOT a copy of latentsync_env), deps from requirements-handover.lock + cu121 index, torch 2.5.1+cu121/CUDA 12.1/2 GPU, all imports OK, fresh-env locked render PROVEN_REAL_PASS (1080x1920 25fps audio+video), truth hash IDENTICAL to existing env. ElevenLabs client imports+configured+voice/check PASS (no quota).
risks.recovery: pip install -r requirements-handover.lock into a fresh venv.

risks.risk: SQLite backup is not scheduled/automated; relies on operator running the script.
risks.evidence: Backup script created + PROVEN_REAL; no scheduler.
risks.mitigation: scripts/backup_studio.py --retain N (default 14) prunes old bundles + scripts/setup_backup_schedule.py optional Task Scheduler installer (install/verify/remove, explicit operator action, no secrets).
risks.recovery: Run backup before any risky change.

risks.risk: Dual-GPU historical hard-crash (GPU0 driver under parallel CUDA, per incident history).
risks.evidence: PROVEN_STATIC — render_service._run_job sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=<gpu> + OFFLINE_USE_MULTI_GPU=false per job (render_service.py:508-513).
risks.mitigation: Per-job single-GPU isolation; one process per GPU.
risks.recovery: Job fails → status=failed + gpu_service.release (PROVEN_STATIC).

risks.risk: verify.py ffprobe fallback is broken (calls imageio_ffmpeg.get_ffprobe_exe which does not exist); if system ffprobe is missing, verify degrades to size>1000 only and cannot check streams/resolution.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_REAL — missing-ffprobe drill returned ok=True with no stream checks; imageio_ffmpeg has get_ffmpeg_exe not get_ffprobe_exe.
risks.mitigation: verify.py _ffprobe fixed: resolves ffprobe via PATH -> FFPROBE_PATH env -> sibling of imageio ffmpeg; when unavailable returns honest ok=False (no size-based fabrication). ffprobe_resolved() added. UNIT_TEST: TestVerifyFallback.
risks.recovery: Install ffprobe on PATH.

risks.risk: Server-side upload has no extension allowlist (dropzone accept is client-side only). Non-video files are accepted into RAW_SOURCES_ROOT then fail at analyze.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_STATIC — app.py uploads route accepts any filename; _sanitize_filename + _within_allowed confine path.
risks.mitigation: Analyze/prepare reject non-video; no path escape (PROVEN_REAL path-traversal drill = HTTP 405).
risks.recovery: N/A.

risks.risk: Accidental tracked secrets.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_REAL — git ls-files shows only .env.example (template, no real key); .env is gitignored; grep for sk_/api_key values found nothing in tracked files.
risks.mitigation: .gitignore covers .env.
risks.recovery: Rotate key if ever leaked.

risks.risk: C: drive ~80GB free and declining; avatars+models on C:.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_REAL — preflight checks disk free on renders + repo drives; warns <15GB repo / <20GB renders.
risks.mitigation: Preflight disk warning; renders go to D: (863GB free).
risks.recovery: Move data/avatars to D: (update config) or clean old renders.

risks.risk: Double-click submission creates two separate jobs (each unique job_id + output path) → duplicate render (wastes GPU/quota). No client-side dedup.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_STATIC — create_*_job generates fresh job_id+uuid output per call; _claim_queued_job is atomic (no double-claim) but two distinct jobs both run.
risks.mitigation: UI disables the submit button after click (app.js renderFull sets qRenderBtn.disabled).
risks.recovery: Cancel the duplicate job.

risks.risk: Good source does NOT guarantee perfect output; model-level small mouth behavior / artifacts possible. System must not over-promise.
risks.evidence: PROVEN_STATIC — quality result is honest (TỐT/CẦN LƯU Ý/KHÔNG KHUYẾN NGHỊ); HDSD must state final visual review required.
risks.mitigation: Output quality acceptance checklist + final manual review.
risks.recovery: Re-render with better source / different avatar.
